patient._comment: 'patient' contains the three sections that may be exposed in the detailed patient display: presentation, answer, and clinical.

presentation._comment: The immutable patient evidence package available for triage. Panel context controls whether other sections are locked or available.
presentation.quote: (his mother) He stopped breathing for a few seconds in the car. He won't finish a bottle. Look at his ribs when he breathes — please, look.
presentation.triageNote: Four-month-old male with three days of coryza, now with marked chest retractions, nasal flaring, poor feeding and a witnessed apnoeic episode.

answer._comment: The authoritative game answer. Explicit ESI, destination, and destination rationale are answer-bearing content; the player's assignment remains session state.
answer.destinationReason: ESI 1 is appropriate because a four-month-old with witnessed apnea, marked retractions, oxygen saturation 88%, heart rate 178, respiratory rate 68, and blood pressure 82/48 requires immediate respiratory support.

clinical._comment: Display-ready clinical interpretation derived from patient.presentation. It preserves clinical meaning but must not explicitly name or identify the correct ESI level or destination; it does not participate in scoring.
clinical.summary: This young infant has severe bronchiolitis with hypoxemia, major work of breathing, poor feeding, and apnea.
clinical.acuityReason: Current gas exchange and ventilation are unstable; young age and apnea create immediate risk of recurrent respiratory arrest.
expectedResources: Nasal suction and respiratory support escalation
IV or enteral hydration when safe
redFlags: Severe work of breathing and hypoxemia
teachingPoints: Apnea may be the presenting manifestation of severe bronchiolitis in young infants.
Feeding should not be forced when work of breathing makes aspiration likely.

possibleDiagnoses: Serious bacterial infection if additional findings emerge
possibleClinicalOutcome.disposition: Immediate respiratory stabilization would be followed by monitored pediatric admission, potentially intensive care.

aiImageGeneration._comment: 'aiImageGeneration' is info for AI to generate the image of the patient. Most images were done with openAI gpt-image-1 using an API, not the app, in July 2026. Look for some python scripts that are used to create these images. Be sure that the anchor-image is available and is provided to the AI - otherwise the images will not be consistent.
aiImageGeneration.who: a hispanic mother seated on the clinic chair cradling her 4-month-old baby boy in her arms
aiImageGeneration.pose: the mother sitting forward cradling the baby across her lap; the baby semi-upright in her arms, chest working hard
aiImageGeneration.expression: the mother frightened and watchful; the baby exhausted and glassy, too tired to cry
signs: deep sucking-in below the baby's ribs with each breath
aiImageGeneration.lookSeverity: a very small infant working far too hard to breathe
aiImageGeneration.prompt: Softly-shaded painterly cartoon illustration in a semi-realistic Pixar/Disney style: smooth gradient shading, soft natural lighting, gentle rounded volumes, fine delicate outlines (NOT thick flat cartoon outlines), warm detailed rendering, natural realistic proportions, EXACTLY TWO characters in one scene. Match the painterly STYLE of the attached reference image - its brushwork, shading, line weight, lighting and palette - but do NOT copy its cropping, camera distance or composition. FRAMING (follow exactly): a full-body WIDE SHOT, square 1:1, 3/4 front view, subject centred. BOTH figures must be completely inside the frame, each from the top of the head to the soles of both feet, and the ENTIRE chair must be inside the frame including all four chair legs meeting the floor. Leave clear empty margin on all four sides - roughly 10% of the image width as space above the head and below the feet. This is NOT a close-up, NOT a bust, NOT a head-and-shoulders portrait, NOT a cropped view: the camera is pulled well back so the whole person and the whole chair sit comfortably inside the picture with room around them. Draw the COMPLETE body - head, neck, torso, both arms, both hands, lap, both legs, both feet with shoes. Nothing cropped by the edges, no missing or truncated limbs, no body part fading out or left unfinished. ANATOMY AND OBJECTS (critical): exactly one head, exactly two arms ending in exactly two hands, exactly two legs ending in two feet, five fingers on each hand. No extra, duplicated, floating or partial limbs anywhere. Anything the character touches must be plausibly held by one of those two hands. All furniture is solid and fully opaque - the chair must never look transparent or see-through, and its back, seat and legs must all be completely drawn. Subject: TWO people. A hispanic mother in her early thirties seated on a blue padded clinic chair, cradling her baby in her arms across her lap. The BABY is the patient: a genuinely tiny 4-month-old infant in a onesie, correctly sized as a real small baby - small enough to lie along his mother's forearms - held semi-upright in her arms. Pose: the mother sitting forward on the chair, cradling the baby securely and looking down at him; the baby lying semi-upright in her arms, his small chest working hard, his arms limp at his sides. Expression: the mother frightened and watchful; the baby exhausted and glassy-eyed, too tired to cry. Clearly visible: deep sucking-in below the baby's ribs with each breath; flaring nostrils; pale mottled skin on the baby; the mother's whole body seated on the chair holding him. Overall: a very small infant working far too hard to breathe. No text, no logos, no watermarks, no border.
